note: SYNTHETIC data. reference_sql hard-codes the month (2026-09, the latest in the sample) so it is computed independently of the SQL under test. expected is the reference result rounded to 4 dp, pasted; the eval re-runs reference_sql and fails if the two ever drift.

questions.question: Which region had the highest net revenue last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-31' GROUP BY region ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many orders were placed last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-09-%'

questions.question: What was the month-over-month change in sales last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT '2026-09', 100.0 * ((SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-09-%') / (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-08-%') - 1)

questions.question: Net revenue by customer segment last month
questions.reference_sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(o.revenue) FROM customers c, orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09-%' GROUP BY c.segment

questions.question: Which product category earned the most turnover last month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(o.revenue) AS r FROM orders o, products p WHERE o.product = p.product AND o.order_date LIKE '2026-09-%' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1
